_ghi_chu: Mô tả chuyển động cho kaggle_animate_2d.py (Wan 2.2). Sinh từ ke-hoach/tam-quoc-tap-2-veo.md, nhóm A và B.

nhom_A.018: Slow push-in. The two foreground men hold their stance and breathe, the rows of spearmen behind them sway and shift their spears together, dust and smoke drift across the field from left to right.
nhom_A.021: Slow lateral drift to the right. Dust and smoke roll through the broken gate, the rear ranks surge forward a few steps in unison, spear tips tilt together, the two foreground men stay in place.
nhom_A.025: Slow forward dolly down the empty lane between the two armies, red banners on the left and blue banners on the right flutter strongly, spear tips sway in unison, dust rises along the lane.
nhom_A.052: Static camera with a slow push-in. The long ranks march forward a few steps in step, tall dark-red banners ripple in the wind, dust rises from their boots, the foreground soldier stands still and breathes.
nhom_A.056: Slow lateral drift along the ridge, the many coloured banners flap in the wind, tent canvas ripples, the formation stays in ranks, the officer in the foreground breathes slightly.
nhom_A.059: Slow push-in toward the platform, the ranks behind stand firm while their spear tips and banners sway in the wind, the two men on the platform stay almost still and breathe.
nhom_A.061: Slow push-in toward the pass gate through mist, the mist drifts between the cliffs, the banners flutter, the ranks of soldiers lift their spears slightly together, the foreground soldier stays still seen from behind.
nhom_A.064: Slow tracking shot, the leader strides forward at a steady pace, the ranks behind advance with him in step, the tall red banner flutters, dust is kicked up. Same leader, same spear, no new fighters.
nhom_A.065: Static camera with a slow upward tilt toward the burning city, flames flicker and black smoke rolls across the sky, embers float, the crowd stands still while cloth and banners move in the wind.
nhom_A.066: Slow push-in, thin smoke curls up from the cold cooking pots, the rows of idle soldiers shift their weight slightly, banners flutter, the foreground man stays seated and breathes.
nhom_A.067: Slow tracking shot walking backwards in front of the column, the soldiers march forward at a steady pace in step, spears upright, the red banner at the head flutters, dust rises from the road.
nhom_A.075: Slow forward drift behind the foreground soldier, the column marches ahead toward the mountain pass, banners flutter, dust glows orange in the setting sun, clouds drift slowly.
nhom_A.079: Slow descending crane move over the valley, columns of tiny soldiers move forward and converge along the river, morning mist drifts, banners flutter, the two foreground commanders stay still.
nhom_A.081: Slow tracking shot alongside the two foreground soldiers as they walk wearily, the long retreating line behind them trudges forward, the torn blue banners flutter, dust drifts, evening light dims slowly.
nhom_A.016: Slow push-in, the long line of waiting men shuffles forward by a small step, banners and cloth flutter, the seated officer and Liu Bei stay almost still.
nhom_A.027: Slow push-in, the lines of townspeople and officials hold their bows, the river in the background glides slowly, clouds drift, Liu Bei stands still and breathes.

nhom_B.003: Slow push-in behind him as he walks away along the moonlit road, cloth bundle swaying, clouds drift across the moon.
nhom_B.014: Slow lateral drift, the small figure keeps walking at a steady pace, moonlight shifts on the road, grass sways.
nhom_B.019: Static camera, grey light shifts slowly through the window, he stands in the doorway and breathes slightly, dust floats in the light.
nhom_B.031: Very slow push-in, torch flames flicker and change the light on their faces, the spears stay upright, they breathe and do not move their arms.
nhom_B.033: Slow push-in, the campfire flames dance and light their faces unevenly, sparks rise, they stay seated and still.
nhom_B.040: Static camera, steam curls up from the pot, the small lamp flame flickers softly, the three men breathe and stay seated.
nhom_B.041: Slow forward dolly behind the three men as they walk side by side, dust rises at their feet, the sunset glow brightens slowly.
nhom_B.050: Static camera with a slow push-in from behind, reeds sway, moonlight shimmers on the water, the two boys stand still and breathe.
nhom_B.057: Slow push-in, a light wind moves his sleeves, clouds drift across the night sky, he stays still.
nhom_B.058: Slow push-in, the planted spears stay still, dust and wind move his sleeves slightly, he stays still.
nhom_B.048: Slow push-in down the corridor, torch flames flicker and long shadows shift, the small figure far down the corridor keeps walking away, the eunuch stays still.
nhom_B.051: Very slow push-in, his cloak moves in a light wind, dust drifts behind him, he stays still.
nhom_B.053: Very slow push-in, light flickers across the room, the two men stay still and breathe.
nhom_B.062: Slow push-in behind him, mist drifts across the valley toward the far pass, his clothes move slightly in the wind.
